Package org.thewhitemage13.service

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.service.NotificationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
NotificationRepositoryInterface
@Transactional @Service public class NotificationService extends Object implements NotificationRepositoryInterface
Service class for managing notifications.

This class implements the NotificationRepositoryInterface and provides methods for creating, updating, and retrieving notifications. It is responsible for the business logic related to notifications, including setting the status of notifications and mapping entity objects to data transfer objects (DTOs).

Key Features:

  • Creates a notification when an order is created, with details like user ID and message.
  • Updates the read status of a notification.
  • Retrieves a list of notifications for a specific user, mapping them to NotificationDTO objects.

    • createNotification

      public void createNotification(@Valid @Valid Notification notification, org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderCreatedEvent)
      Creates a new notification based on the provided OrderCreatedEvent.

      This method sets the notification's read status to false, associates it with the user ID from the OrderCreatedEvent, and saves it to the database.

      Specified by:
      createNotification in interface NotificationRepositoryInterface
      Parameters:
      notification - the Notification object to be created
      orderCreatedEvent - the OrderCreatedEvent containing the order details

    • updateStatus

      public void updateStatus(Long notificationId, boolean status) throws NotificationNotFoundException
      Updates the read status of a notification.

      This method updates the "read" status of a notification based on its ID. If the notification is not found, a NotificationNotFoundException is thrown.

      Specified by:
      updateStatus in interface NotificationRepositoryInterface
      Parameters:
      notificationId - the ID of the notification to update
      status - the new read status of the notification
      Throws:
      NotificationNotFoundException - if no notification with the specified ID is found
